title: "A-1 camera" – U-2 reconnaissance camera system photo (Chapter 2, p. 51)
description: Very dark, nearly black reproduction of a photograph captioned "A-1 camera"; the camera equipment itself is barely discernible in the scan. The text below explains that the A-1 system consisted of two 24-inch K-38 framing cameras, one vertical and one in a rocking mount for left and right obliques, using 9.5-inch film.
